atq.text: Terisiare is where the ancient artifacts and war machines of the Thran Empire are discovered, and where Urza and Mishra are sent to study at Tocasia's archaeological dig.
Their rivalry over the two halves of the stone causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death, removing the brothers' last restraining influence, and the Brothers' War erupts.
The battle becomes an all-consuming war that kills millions and strips Terisiare of resources, and Terisia City is destroyed by Mishra.
Later the Flooding of Terisiare breaks the continent into the Terisian archipelago.

drk.text: In The Dark, the Church of Tal rules Terisiare's war-ravaged city-states and seeks to eradicate artifice and magic.
After the fall of the College of Lat-Nam, Drafna and other Third Path survivors found the City of Shadows in hiding, where Sima meets her future husband Jodah.
Tivadar's Knightly Order, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, restores civilization by throwing back the Goblin Invasions, ending the Dark.

csp.text: In Coldsnap, Terisiare enters the Thaw as its icy shell melts and most inhabitants rejoice at the land's rebirth.
When Freyalise speaks the World Spell the tamanoa rise to bring a new morning, but as the Thaw meets the continent, mountains shed their ice, crushing homes.
A secretive society of mages tries to use the time of change to shroud the continent in its icy magic, until Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter.
